issues.claim: one_line: 'buyers on builder forums report $0.12-$0.40 per minute all-in'
issues.problem: The forum figures are Retell platform cost only, not all-in. The thread's headline number is explicitly 'around $0.17 US per minute ... This is JUST the retellai cost', and that poster separates middleware/API spend as an additional cost. The brief's own buyer_reported_costs entry says the same ('excluding separate middleware/API spend'), so the one_line contradicts its own sourced detail by labelling the band 'all-in'.
issues.fix: Reword to 'buyers on builder forums report $0.12-$0.40 per minute in platform cost (middleware/API extra)', or state platform + carrier + middleware separately. Do not describe the forum band as all-in.

issues.claim: one_line: '($0.31-$0.38 at the premium voice/model end)'
issues.problem: Not derivable from the sourced prices and not labelled as inference. $0.31 is Retell's own headline maximum (confirmed on the pricing page); $0.38 is the GPT Realtime 2.1 per-minute LLM component, a part rather than an all-in figure. The two endpoints come from different kinds of number and no derivation is given, and the number does not reappear in any price_ranges band.
issues.fix: Recompute and show the build, e.g. Retell voice engine $0.055 + ElevenLabs v3 $0.10 + GPT 5.5 $0.16 + telephony $0.015 = ~$0.33/min (a straightforward premium configuration), label it 'Inference', or delete the parenthetical.

issues.claim: what_is_included_vs_extra #1: 'Retell's headline $0.07-$0.31/min is the sum of voice engine $0.055 + TTS $0.015-$0.10 + LLM $0.0016-$0.38 + telephony $0.015'
issues.problem: The stated components do not sum to the stated endpoints. Cheapest combination = $0.055 + $0.015 + $0.0016 + $0.015 = $0.0866/min; most expensive = $0.055 + $0.10 + $0.38 + $0.015 = $0.55/min. Neither $0.07 nor $0.31 is reproduced, so the sentence presents an arithmetic relationship as fact that the rate card contradicts. (Each individual figure is correct on the page; the 'is the sum of' claim is not.)
issues.fix: Replace with something the numbers support: 'Retell's headline band is composed of voice engine $0.055 + TTS $0.015-$0.10 + LLM $0.0016-$0.384 + telephony $0.015, which sums to roughly $0.087-$0.55/min depending on voice and model chosen' - labelled Inference.

issues.claim: price_ranges.full_service_or_custom: 'No vendor in this set publishes a one-time setup fee except Sarah247, which states setup is included.'
issues.problem: Self-contradictory: Sarah247 states setup is included, which means it publishes no setup fee either. The sentence reads as if Sarah247 is the one exception with a published fee. (Retell's $10 one-time verified-number fee is also not a setup fee.)
issues.fix: Rewrite: 'No vendor in this set publishes a one-time setup fee; Sarah247 states setup is included in the $350/month base. Retell's one-time $10 is per verified number, not a setup fee.' Setup-fee absence supports no setup-fee band, as the inference_note already says.

issues.claim: caveats: 'Telnyx's voice-ai-agents URL now resolves at /pricing/conversational-ai, which is the URL cited here'
issues.problem: Backwards. I opened the cited https://telnyx.com/pricing/conversational-ai and it serves the voice-agent pricing page whose canonical URL and breadcrumb are https://telnyx.com/pricing/voice-ai-agents (dateModified 2026-10-01). The cited URL does work, so this is a wording error in the caveat rather than a broken citation, but as written it misdescribes which URL is canonical.
issues.fix: Reword: 'The cited /pricing/conversational-ai URL serves the same page as /pricing/voice-ai-agents, which is its canonical URL.'

issues.claim: Twilio offering rows: US outbound $0.014/min, US inbound local $0.0085/min, US local number $1.15/month
issues.problem: Not confirmable from the vendor page itself: fetching https://www.twilio.com/en-us/voice/pricing/us returns 854 characters of marketing copy with no rate table (the brief discloses this). I re-ran search against the same URL and the returned rendering does show $0.0140/min outbound, $0.0085/min inbound local, $0.0220/min toll-free inbound and $1.15/month local number - so the figures are corroborated by a search rendering of the cited URL, not by an opened rate card. Not a price error, but these are the only prices in the file with no machine-readable vendor page behind them.
issues.fix: Keep the UNVERIFIED labels and the caveat, and do not let Twilio rates carry weight in any quoted range (they currently do not). Optionally note that the toll-free $0.022/min figure is now corroborated by the same search rendering and could be unflagged, while call recording ($0.0025/min) and the $2.15/month toll-free rental remain unconfirmed.
